title: Hwy. 46 and Coughran Road

rows.label: Location
rows.text: The property is at the Northeast corner of Hwy. 46 and Coughran Road next to Home Depot.

rows.label: Zoning
rows.text: OCL. Property has also been removed from ETJ.
rows.note: Prospective buyers should verify the zoning and permitted uses for this property with the appropriate governing authority.

rows.label: Flood Plain
rows.text: FEMA maps do not appear to show any floodplain on the property.

rows.label: Easements
rows.text: Various electricity easements, Texas Water Company easement

rows.label: Traffic Count
rows.text: 2025 Texas Department of Transportation counts show 10,340 vehicles per day on SH 46 beside the property and 49,714 vehicles per day on IH 10, 0.4 miles away.

rows.label: Demographics
rows.note: Source: CRE Agents Demographics Report for 633 West Bandera Road, Boerne, TX, generated October 8, 2026; U.S. Census Bureau American Community Survey 5-Year Estimates.

rows.label: Area Development
rows.text: Across Hwy. 46 from the new Spencer Ranch Development. Adjacent to Home Depot, Whataburger and Chili’s. Also near newly planned Baptist Hospital as well as HEB.

rows.label: Potential Uses
rows.text: Retail, restaurant, bank, and other commercial uses

comments: Hwy 46 expansion being planned in this area (potential lighted intersection)
